heroSubtitulo: Understand what it means, whether it's valid, and what you can do
disclaimer: Educational tool, not legal advice. Consult a lawyer.
footer: Independent project — not affiliated with MINGOB
sugerirIdiomaDesc: Do you know a language we should support? Tell us which.
menuBuscarDesc: Enter your plate and check for fines in your municipality
menuMultaDesc: You have the paper ticket: enter its details
menuInfoDesc: Fine types explained in plain language
formFisicaSubtitulo: Fill in the details from your ticket to look it up
errorNoEncontradoNota: Check that the plate and entity are correct.
notifFotoDesc: Fine by camera or sensor: no one stopped you and there is no physical photo. You only find out when checking your plate here. Notification is TODAY, the day you first saw it on this portal.
notifFisicaDesc: Physical fine (paper): the notification date is the day the agent HANDED you the document. If you were stopped for something you just did, it is the same day. If they handed you a paper for an older fine (e.g. camera), it is the delivery date, not the offense date.
multasListSub: select one to see the details
multasListSin: No pending fines for this plate and entity.
notifLabel: When were you notified of this fine?
notifNota: Platforms (SAT, EMETRA, municipalities) don't provide the notification date. If you saw it here on the portal, the date is TODAY. If it's a physical fine, the date is the same as the issue date.
notifHoy: Today (I saw it on the portal)
tlPrescripcionDetalle: 120 days from issue: if it passes, the fine prescribes and you can request its removal.
estadoApelableDesc: You're within the 15 days from notification. You have the right to appeal the fine or pay it. The appeal deadline expires on
estadoSoloPagoDesc: The 15 days from your notification have passed. You can no longer appeal: you can only pay the fine.
estadoPrescritaDesc: More than 120 days have passed since issue without the process being completed. This fine has prescribed and you shouldn't pay it.
botonQuitarMulta: I want to remove the fine
quitarMultaDesc: Do you think the fine isn't valid or has already prescribed? We can help you prepare the appeal to have it removed.
apelacionTexto: You can appeal at the corresponding traffic court within the legal deadlines. Bring your ticket, ID, and supporting documents.
pagoTexto: You can pay at the counters of the entity that issued the fine or through authorized channels. Paying within the first 15 days may apply a discount.
tamanoDesc: Choose the text size for the whole app
errorNoEncontrado3dias: Remissions take up to 3 days to appear. If your fine doesn't show up, wait 3 days from the day you got it.
errorNoMulta6: The fine number must have 6 digits
razonClaraDefault: This infraction was recorded against the vehicle's plate according to current traffic regulations.
buscarAyudaPlaca: type the plate exactly as it appears on the vehicle
pagoNotaDescuento: Remember: paying within the first 15 days from notification may apply a discount.
pagoBancoIndustrial: Banco Industrial (Mixco, Santa Catarina Pinula, Fraijanes)
pagoPortalSATDesc: Check and pay online from the SAT portal
pagoPresencialDesc: Counters of the entity that issued the fine
pagoEnLineaDesc: Virtual banking of the authorized bank
pagoNoOficial: This app does not process payments. We only guide you on where and how to pay.
pagoPaso1: Identify the entity that issued your fine (PNC, EMETRA, municipality)
pagoPaso2: Choose the payment channel: online, virtual banking, or counter
pagoPaso3: Have your fine number and plate ready
pagoPaso5: Verify on the portal that the fine shows as paid
pagoExitoDesc: This is an educational prototype: no real charge was made.
pagoPortalOficialDesc: You will be redirected to the website of the entity that issued the fine
pagoSimulacionNota: Educational simulation — this app does not process real payments
recargoAnual: The amount increases 20% per year starting one year after notification.
